utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Ashcombe Haulage, this is Kofi.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Hi Kofi, it's Sam from Vantrellis. I saw your team finished the Harlow Street job last week. How did that land?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Ha, it was a sprint, but we got there. Thanks for asking.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: What's the biggest challenge with dispatch right now?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: It takes too long. Our dispatcher spends most of every Friday afternoon on it.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: If nothing changes over the next six months, what does that cost you?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Honestly? A customer worth about sixty thousand a year. And people are tired of it.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: What would success look like by the end of the quarter?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Get dispatch down to thirty minutes a day, and zero missed pickups.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Let me make sure I have this right. Our dispatcher spends most of every Friday afternoon on dispatching drivers, and things still slip. Did I miss anything?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: No, that's it exactly.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Our platform helps teams like yours schedule faster and keep everyone updated. It has mobile alerts, reporting, and integrations with the tools you already use.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Okay. What does something like that cost?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: For a team your size it's twenty-four thousand dollars a year.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Hmm. That's more than we budgeted for.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: What were you comparing it to?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: I guess I was thinking of the cost of the spreadsheet, which is nothing.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Fair. Earlier you mentioned a customer worth about sixty thousand a year. How does the price compare to that?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: When you put it that way, it's not crazy.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Does what you've seen so far make sense for your team?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Can you just send me some info and I'll look it over?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Sure, I'll send over our deck and a case study.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Let's reconnect sometime next week.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Sure, sounds good.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Thanks Kofi, really appreciate the time.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Thanks, bye.

tone_windows.note: Rep does most of the talking in this stretch.
